newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 21.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Extension of Abidjan-Yamoussoukro motorway will speed transfer of government to Ivory Coast's designated political capital in the interior. Toll plaza to be in place on motorway in three months under plan for financing of project by private sector. - The Food and Agriculture Organisation's director general Jacques Diouf visits Ivorian President Henri Konan Bedie. LA VOIE - One student killed on Abobo campus of University of Abidjan in clash with police; elsewhere in Abidjan, campuses empty ahead of 72-hour strike from Wednesday called by radical student union, FESCI, to protest jailing of three leaders of the banned organisation. LE JOUR - Managing director of Ivory Coast Gas company taken hostage during protest by staff over pay arrears. - Utexi textile mill in central Ivory Coast recorded turnover of 70.2 billion CFA france in 1995-96, planning minister Theophile N'Doli told during visit.
